title.en: Volume 312 Biographies 99: Fu Qing, La Bu Dun, Ban Di, E Rongan, Na Mu Zha Er, San Tai
title.raw: 卷312 列傳九十九 傅清 拉布敦 班第 鄂容安 纳穆札尔 三泰

sentences.zh: 列傳九十九

translations.literal: Biographies 99
translations.idiomatic: Biography 99

sentences.zh: 傅清拉布敦班第子巴祿鄂容安納穆札爾三泰

translations.literal: Fu Qing, Labudun, Bandi, Zibalü, E Rong'an, Namuzhal, and San Tai
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qing, Labudun, Bandi, Zibalü, E Rong'an, Namuzhal, and San Tai

sentences.zh: 傅清，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，李榮保次子，傅恆弟也。

translations.literal: Fu Qing, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, the second son of Li Rongbao and younger brother of Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qing belonged to the Fuca clan and the Bordered Yellow Banner. He was Li Rongbao's second son and Fu Heng's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，授侍衛。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng reign he was appointed a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng era he entered service as an imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，累遷至直隸天津鎮總兵。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign he was promoted in succession until he became commander of Zhili's Tianjin garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong's reign he rose through successive posts to command the Tianjin garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 康熙中定西藏，留兵鎮撫，以大臣駐藏辦事，為員二，嗣省其一。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi reign Tibet was pacified, troops were left to garrison and reassure the region, and ministers were stationed in Tibet to handle affairs, originally two in number; later one post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After Tibet was secured in the Kangxi period, a garrison and resident ministers were left in place—first two commissioners, later reduced to one.

sentences.zh: 是時駐藏副都統索拜當代，命傅清以副都統往。

translations.literal: At that time the deputy commander stationed in Tibet, Suobai, was due to be relieved; Fu Qing was ordered to go as deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Suobai was then the deputy commander in Tibet; Fu Qing was sent to replace him in that post.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏言：「西藏處徼外，西北界準噶爾，北通青海，為四川西南外郛。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "Tibet lies beyond the frontier; on the northwest it borders the Dzungars, on the north it connects with Qinghai, and it forms the outer bulwark southwest of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he submitted a memorial: "Tibet stands on the outer frontier: the Dzungars lie to the northwest, Qinghai to the north, and the region is Sichuan's southwestern rampart.

sentences.zh: 自雍正十二年設塘汛，不特傳送官文書，且以聯絡聲氣。

translations.literal: Since the twelfth year of Yongzheng postal stations have been established, not only to relay official documents but also to maintain communication and intelligence.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yongzheng 12, relay stations have carried official mail and kept lines of communication open.

sentences.zh: 上年索拜以節費議撤汛，使藏人任郵遞，謂之番塘。

translations.literal: Last year Suobai, to save expense, proposed abolishing the stations and having Tibetans handle the courier service, calling it the "Tibetan relay."
translations.idiomatic: The year before, Suobai had proposed cutting costs by abolishing the stations and entrusting the route to Tibetan couriers—the so-called "Tibetan relay."

sentences.zh: 未幾輒被盜。

translations.literal: Before long it was repeatedly robbed.
translations.idiomatic: Within a short time the route was repeatedly plundered.

sentences.zh: 今準噶爾當入藏熬茶，番塘恐滋誤。

translations.literal: Now, when Dzungars are about to enter Tibet for the tea pilgrimage, the Tibetan relay is likely to cause mishaps.
translations.idiomatic: With Dzungars soon coming to Tibet for the tea pilgrimage, relying on the Tibetan relay could easily go wrong.

sentences.zh: 請自打箭爐至藏復置塘汛，酌衝僻遠近，當得兵千人以內。

translations.literal: I request that stations be re-established from Dartsedo to Tibet, with troops allocated according to whether each stretch is busy or remote, totaling no more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that stations be restored from Dartsedo to Lhasa, with garrisons scaled to traffic and terrain, within a total of about a thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 」議如所請。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved his request.

sentences.zh: 十二年，西藏郡王頗羅鼐卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Tibetan prince of the commandery Polhané died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Polhané, prince of the commandery in Tibet, died.

sentences.zh: 頗羅鼐愛其次子珠爾默特那木札勒，請以為嗣，遂襲爵為郡王。

translations.literal: Polhané favored his second son Dondrup Namjal and asked that he succeed; Dondrup Namjal thereupon inherited the title of prince of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Polhané favored his second son Dondrup Namjal and had him named heir; the son then succeeded as prince of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 上諭傅清曰：「頗羅鼐更事多，黽勉事中國。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Fu Qing: "Polhané had wide experience and strove diligently on China's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told Fu Qing: "Polhané was seasoned in affairs and served the dynasty faithfully.

sentences.zh: 珠爾默特那木札勒幼，傅清宜留意。

translations.literal: Dondrup Namjal is young; Fu Qing should pay attention to him.
translations.idiomatic: Dondrup Namjal is still young—Fu Qing should watch him closely.

sentences.zh: 如珠爾默特那木札勒思慮所未至，當為指示。

translations.literal: Wherever Dondrup Namjal has not yet thought matters through, you should instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: Where his judgment falls short, you should guide him.

sentences.zh: 」傅清疏言：「頗羅鼐在時，長子公珠爾默特策布登出駐阿里克夏，當令珠爾默特那木札勒帥師出駐騰格里諾爾、喀喇烏蘇諸處。

translations.literal: " Fu Qing memorialized: "While Polhané lived, his eldest son Gongzhu'ermute Cebden was stationed at Ali Kexia; Dondrup Namjal should be made to lead troops and garrison Tenggeli Nuor, Kala Wusu, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: " Fu Qing wrote: "Under Polhané, the eldest son Gongzhu'ermute Cebden held Ali Kexia; Dondrup Namjal should command troops at Tenggeli Nuor, Kala Wusu, and similar posts.

sentences.zh: 今仍遣珠爾默特策布登駐阿里克夏，令別遣宰桑駐騰格里諾爾、喀喇烏蘇諸處。

translations.literal: Now Gongzhu'ermute Cebden should still be left at Ali Kexia, but another zaisang should be sent to garrison Tenggeli Nuor, Kala Wusu, and the other places.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed keeping Cebden at Ali Kexia while posting a separate zaisang to the Tenggeli Nuor and Kala Wusu lines.

sentences.zh: 」又以準噶爾入藏熬茶，請增兵分路防護。

translations.literal: " He also asked, because Dzungars were entering Tibet for the tea pilgrimage, to increase troops to guard the routes in several directions.
translations.idiomatic: " He also sought extra troops along several routes because Dzungars were coming for the tea pilgrimage.

sentences.zh: 上命與珠爾默特那木札勒商榷，毋涉張皇。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered him to consult with Dondrup Namjal and not be alarmist.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told him to consult Dondrup Namjal and avoid alarmism.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命以提督拉布敦代，傅清還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to have Labudun, provincial commander, replace him, and Fu Qing returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Labudun, as provincial commander, replaced him and Fu Qing returned.

sentences.zh: 复授天津鎮總兵，遷古北口、固原提督。

translations.literal: He was again appointed commander of the Tianjin garrison and was promoted to provincial commander at Gubeikou and Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He resumed command at Tianjin and was later promoted to provincial commander at Gubeikou and Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 珠爾默特那木札勒請撤留藏兵，上從之。

translations.literal: Dondrup Namjal asked to withdraw the troops left in Tibet; the Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: Dondrup Namjal requested withdrawal of the Tibetan garrison; the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 旋以副都統紀山代拉布敦。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the deputy commander Ji Shan replaced Labudun.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, deputy commander Ji Shan replaced Labudun.

sentences.zh: 十四年，紀山疏言珠爾默特那木札勒與達賴喇嘛有隙，請移達賴喇嘛置泰宁。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Ji Shan memorialized that Dondrup Namjal was at odds with the Dalai Lama and asked that the Dalai Lama be moved to Taining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Ji Shan reported a rift between Dondrup Namjal and the Dalai Lama and proposed moving the Dalai Lama to Taining.

sentences.zh: 上知珠爾默特那木札勒乖戾且為亂，命駐藏大臣復舊置二員，予傅清都統銜，自固原復往。

translations.literal: The Emperor knew Dondrup Namjal was perverse and would rebel; he ordered the restoration of the former two resident commissioners, gave Fu Qing the rank of commander-in-chief, and sent him from Guyuan to Tibet again.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Dondrup Namjal was unruly and likely to rebel, the Emperor restored two resident commissioners, gave Fu Qing a commander-in-chief's seal, and sent him back from Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 紀山复疏謂珠爾默特那木札勒言其兄珠爾默特策布登將舉兵相攻，上命傅清途中诇虛實。

translations.literal: Ji Shan again memorialized that Dondrup Namjal said his elder brother Gongzhu'ermute Cebden would raise troops to attack him; the Emperor ordered Fu Qing to investigate the truth en route.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Shan then claimed Dondrup Namjal feared his brother Cebden would attack; the Emperor told Fu Qing to verify this on the road.

sentences.zh: 傅清疏言：「珠爾默特策布登未嘗構兵，特珠爾默特那木札勒妄言，藉以奪其兄分地。

translations.literal: Fu Qing memorialized: "Gongzhu'ermute Cebden has never raised troops; it is only Dondrup Namjal's false talk, by which he seeks to seize his brother's allotted territory.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qing replied that Cebden had not mobilized—that Dondrup Namjal invented the threat to seize his brother's lands.

sentences.zh: 臣至藏，即將珠爾默特那木札勒懲治。

translations.literal: When I reach Tibet I will punish Dondrup Namjal at once.
translations.idiomatic: "Once I reach Tibet," he wrote, "I will punish Dondrup Namjal immediately."

sentences.zh: 」是時上已遣侍郎拉布敦代紀山，因諭傅清，珠爾默特那木札勒乖戾且為亂，令熟計密奏。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor had already sent Vice Minister Labudun to replace Ji Shan, and therefore instructed Fu Qing that Dondrup Namjal was perverse and would rebel, and to plan carefully and report in secret.
translations.idiomatic: By then Vice Minister Labudun was replacing Ji Shan; the Emperor again warned Fu Qing that Dondrup Namjal was treacherous and would rebel, and to plan in secret.

sentences.zh: 十五年，傅清與拉布敦先後至藏，珠爾默特那木札勒迫其兄珠爾默特策布登至死，遂逐其子，遣使通準噶爾，叛益有跡。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Fu Qing and Labudun reached Tibet in succession; Dondrup Namjal forced his elder brother Gongzhu'ermute Cebden to his death, then drove out his son, sent envoys to the Dzungars, and rebellion became increasingly evident.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Fu Qing and Labudun arrived; Dondrup Namjal killed his brother Cebden, expelled the nephew, contacted the Dzungars, and rebellion showed plainly.

sentences.zh: 上命副都統班第赴西藏，與傅清、拉布敦密謀取進止，仍詔傅清、拉布敦毋輕發，並密諭四川總督策楞勒兵為備。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Deputy Commander Bandi to go to Tibet to consult secretly with Fu Qing and Labudun on what course to take, still instructing Fu Qing and Labudun not to act rashly, and secretly ordering Sichuan Governor Celeng to ready troops.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Deputy Commander Bandi to consult secretly with Fu Qing and Labudun while still cautioning them against rash action, and secretly ordered Governor Celeng of Sichuan to prepare forces.

sentences.zh: 珠爾默特那木札勒謀愈急，絕塘汛，軍書不得達。

translations.literal: Dondrup Namjal's plotting grew more urgent; he cut off the relay stations so military dispatches could not get through.
translations.idiomatic: Dondrup Namjal's plotting intensified; he severed the relay route so dispatches could not pass.

sentences.zh: 傅清與拉布敦未得上詔，計以為：「珠爾默特那木札勒且叛，徒為所屠。

translations.literal: Fu Qing and Labudun, unable to receive imperial instructions, reasoned among themselves: "Dondrup Namjal is about to rebel; we will merely be slaughtered by him.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to receive fresh orders, Fu Qing and Labudun reasoned: "He is about to rebel—we will only be butchered.

sentences.zh: 亂既成，吾軍不得即進，是棄兩藏也。

translations.literal: Once rebellion is complete our troops cannot advance at once—that is to abandon both Tibets.
translations.idiomatic: If rebellion breaks out fully, relief cannot reach us in time—we would abandon both Tibets.

sentences.zh: 不如先發，雖亦死，亂乃易定。

translations.literal: It is better to strike first; though we too will die, the disorder will be easier to settle.
translations.idiomatic: Better to strike first: we may still die, but the turmoil will be far easier to quell.

sentences.zh: 十月壬午，召珠爾默特那木札勒至通司岡駐藏大臣署，言有詔，使登樓，預去其梯，若將宣詔。

translations.literal: On the day renchen of the tenth month Dondrup Namjal was summoned to the resident commissioners' office at Tamsikang on the pretext that there was an edict; he was made to ascend a tower, the ladder was removed beforehand, as if an edict were about to be proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's renchen day they summoned Dondrup Namjal to the commissioners' hall at Tamsikang, saying an edict awaited him. He climbed a tower whose ladder had been removed, as though to hear a proclamation.

sentences.zh: 珠爾默特那木札勒方拜跪，傅清自後揮刀斷其首。

translations.literal: As Dondrup Namjal was bowing in obeisance, Fu Qing struck from behind with a blade and severed his head.
translations.idiomatic: While he knelt in obeisance, Fu Qing cut off his head from behind.

sentences.zh: 於是其黨羅卜藏札什始率眾圍樓數重，發槍砲，縱火，傅清中三創，度不免，自剄死。

translations.literal: Thereupon his partisan Lobzang Tashi led the masses to surround the tower in many rings, firing muskets and cannon and setting fires; Fu Qing received three wounds, saw he could not escape, and cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: His follower Lobzang Tashi then ringed the tower with musket and cannon fire and set it ablaze. Fu Qing took three wounds, knew escape was impossible, and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 拉布敦死樓下。

translations.literal: Labudun died below the tower.
translations.idiomatic: Labudun died at the foot of the tower.

sentences.zh: 主事策塔爾、參將黃元龍皆自殺。

translations.literal: Clerk Cetar and Colonel Huang Yuanlong both killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Cetar and Colonel Huang Yuanlong also took their own lives.

sentences.zh: 通判常明中矢石死。

translations.literal: Subprefect Chang Ming died from arrows and stones.
translations.idiomatic: Subprefect Chang Ming was killed by arrow and stone fire.

sentences.zh: 從死者千總二、兵四十九、商民七十七。

translations.literal: Those who died with them included two company commanders, forty-nine soldiers, and seventy-seven merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Two platoon leaders, forty-nine soldiers, and seventy-seven merchants died with them.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上軫悼，宣示始末，謂其「揆幾審勢，決計定謀，心苦而功大」。

translations.literal: When word reached the throne the Emperor grieved deeply, proclaimed the whole course of events, and said of them that they had "weighed the moment, judged the situation, resolved on a plan with fixed purpose—heart bitter yet achievement great."
translations.idiomatic: When news reached court the Emperor mourned them, published the full account, and praised their "bitter resolve and great achievement" in reading the moment and acting decisively.

sentences.zh: 傅清追封一等伯，諡襄烈，旋命立祠通司岡。

translations.literal: Fu Qing was posthumously enfeoffed as a first-class baron with the posthumous title Xianglie; he was soon ordered to have a shrine erected at Tamsikang.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qing was posthumously made a first-class baron with the temple name Xianglie, and a shrine was ordered at Tamsikang.

sentences.zh: 喪還，上臨奠。

translations.literal: When the coffin returned the Emperor came in person to offer mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When his coffin returned, the Emperor mourned him in person.

sentences.zh: 其子孫以一等子世襲，賜白金萬。

translations.literal: His descendants received hereditary succession as first-class viscounts, and ten thousand taels of silver were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: His line received a hereditary first-class viscounty and ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 班第至藏，戮羅卜藏札什等，疏陳珠爾默特那木札勒自立名號，通款準噶爾，稱策旺多爾濟那木札勒為汗，請其發兵至拉達克為聲援。

translations.literal: When Bandi reached Tibet he executed Lobzang Tashi and others, and memorialized that Dondrup Namjal had set up his own title, communicated with the Dzungars, called Tsewang Dorji Namjal khan, and asked him to send troops to Ladakh as a supporting demonstration.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi, arriving later, executed Lobzang Tashi and others and reported that Dondrup Namjal had taken a royal title, treated with the Dzungars, hailed Tsewang Dorji Namjal as khan, and sought Dzungar troops toward Ladakh as backing.

sentences.zh: 上复降詔褒傅清、拉布敦，建祠京師，命曰雙忠。

translations.literal: The Emperor again issued an edict praising Fu Qing and Labudun, built a shrine in the capital, and named it Shuangzhong [Double Loyalty].
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor again praised Fu Qing and Labudun, built a capital shrine named Shuangzhong (Double Loyalty).

sentences.zh: 子明仁，以侍衛襲子爵。

translations.literal: His son Mingren inherited the viscounty as a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mingren inherited the viscounty as a guardsman.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，卒於軍。

translations.literal: On campaign in the Jinchuan wars he died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He later died on campaign in the Jinchuan wars.

sentences.zh: 拉布敦，棟鄂氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Labudun, of the Dong'e clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Labudun, of the Dong'e clan, belonged to the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 其先對齊巴顏，於太祖時率所部來歸，語見阿蘭珠、朗格諸傳。

translations.literal: His ancestor Duichiba, in the time of Taizu, led his tribe to submit; the account appears in the biographies of Alanzhu, Langge, and others.
translations.idiomatic: An ancestor, Duichiba, submitted with his people in Taizu's time—the story appears in the biographies of Alanzhu, Langge, and others.

sentences.zh: 父錫勒達事聖祖，自讚禮郎累遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: His father Xileda served the Kangxi Emperor, rising from Master of Ceremonies through successive promotions to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xileda served the Kangxi Emperor, rising from Master of Ceremonies to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 出署川陝總督，還京師。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan, then returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan, then returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以鎮筸苗為亂，命偕副都統圖斯海、徐九如帥師討之，降三百一寨，剿十五寨。

translations.literal: When the Miao of Zhenbian rebelled he was ordered, together with Deputy Commander Tusi Hai and Xu Jiuru, to lead troops against them; three hundred and one stockades submitted and fifteen were subdued by force.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhenbian Miao rebelled, he joined Deputy Commanders Tusi Hai and Xu Jiuru in suppressing them—301 stockades submitted and fifteen were taken by force.

sentences.zh: 錫勒達與荊州副都統珠滿、湖廣提督俞益謨所戡定者，天星寨、龍椒洞、排六樑等三寨。

translations.literal: Those subdued by Xileda together with Jingzhou Deputy Commander Zhuman and Huguang Provincial Commander Yu Yimo included the three stockades of Tianxing, Longjiaodong, and Pailiuliang.
translations.idiomatic: With Jingzhou Deputy Commander Zhuman and Huguang Commander Yu Yimo he reduced Tianxing, Longjiaodong, and Pailiuliang stockades.

sentences.zh: 亂定，與總督於成龍、巡撫趙申喬議立營汛，增設官吏為撫綏，復還京師。

translations.literal: When the disorder was settled he discussed with Governor Yu Chenglong and Provincial Governor Zhao Shenqiao establishing garrison posts and adding officials for pacification, then returned again to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After pacification he worked with Governor Yu Chenglong and Provincial Governor Zhao Shenqiao to establish garrisons and civil posts, then returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 拉布敦，其第六子也。

translations.literal: Labudun was his sixth son.
translations.idiomatic: Labudun was his sixth son.

sentences.zh: 生有力，能彎十力弓，左右射。

translations.literal: From birth he was strong and could draw a ten-strength bow and shoot with either hand.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built from youth, could draw a ten-strength bow, and shot equally well left- or right-handed.

sentences.zh: 工詩文，習外國語言。

translations.literal: He was skilled in poetry and prose and studied foreign languages.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote poetry and prose and studied foreign languages.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，襲叔祖勒爾圖三等阿達哈哈番世職。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi reign he inherited his uncle's third-rank adaha hafan hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi he inherited his uncle's third-rank adaha hafan hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 雍正朝，從傅爾丹討準噶爾，戰於和通呼爾哈諾爾；

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign he followed Fu'erdan in campaigning against the Dzungars and fought at Hoton Khurha Nuur;
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng's time he campaigned under Fu'erdan against the Dzungars and fought at Hoton Khurha Nuor;

sentences.zh: 又從策淩討準噶爾，戰於額爾德尼昭：皆有所斬馘，授世管佐領。

translations.literal: he also followed Celeng against the Dzungars and fought at Erdeni Zhao: in both he took heads in battle and was granted a hereditary company commandership.
translations.idiomatic: he also fought under Celeng at Erdeni Zhao, taking enemy heads in both campaigns and earning a hereditary company commandership.

sentences.zh: 上命軍中舉驍勇之士，拉布敦與焉，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the army to nominate valiant men; Labudun was among them and received a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When the throne called for the bravest men in the army, Labudun was chosen and given a peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，累遷正紅旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign he was promoted in succession to deputy commander of the Bordered Red Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong's reign he rose to deputy commander of the Bordered Red Manchu Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，复討準噶爾，授參贊大臣，出北路。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again campaigned against the Dzungars and was made coordinating commissioner, taking the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined another Dzungar campaign as coordinating commissioner on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 九年，授定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier.

sentences.zh: 其冬，疏言：「厄魯特宰桑額勒慎等內牧布爾吉推河，烏梁海得木齊札木禪內牧布延圖河源。

translations.literal: That winter he memorialized: "Dzungar zaisang Eleshen and others are grazing inside at the Burji Tui River; Oirat Demchi Zhamchen is grazing inside at the source of the Buyantu River.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he reported Dzungar zaisang grazing inside the Burji Tui River and Oirat lamas inside the Buyantu headwaters.

sentences.zh: 布爾吉推河在阿爾台山梁外，布延圖河源在阿爾台山梁內，距卡倫不遠，已闉坐卡侍衛等嚴防。

translations.literal: The Burji Tui lies beyond the Altai ridge; the Buyantu source lies within it, not far from the border posts, and garrison guards have already been stationed to enforce strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: Burji Tui lies beyond the Altai ridge; Buyantu's source lies within it, close to border posts already manned under strict watch.

sentences.zh: 」十年冬，疏言：「烏梁海得木齊烏爾巴齊等避雪，內牧黃加書魯克，距卡倫不遠。

translations.literal: " In the winter of the tenth year he memorialized: "Oirat Demchi Urbaqi and others, avoiding snow, are grazing inside at Huangjiashuluke, not far from the border posts.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth year's winter he noted Oirat herders sheltering from snow at Huangjiashuluke, again near the posts.

sentences.zh: 託爾和烏蘭、布延圖、哈瑪爾沙海諸卡倫外，皆有準噶爾人踪跡，仍闉坐卡侍衛等嚴防。

translations.literal: Beyond the posts at Tuo'erhe Wulan, Buyantu, and Hamar Shahai there are also traces of Dzungar people; garrison guards are still stationed for strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: He reported Dzungar tracks beyond posts at Tuo'erhe Wulan, Buyantu, and Hamar Shahai, with guards still stationed.

sentences.zh: 」尋召還京師，授正白旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: " Soon he was recalled to the capital and appointed deputy commander of the Plain White Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: " He was soon recalled and made deputy commander of the Plain White Manchu Banner.

sentences.zh: 復出署古北口提督。

translations.literal: He went out again to serve as acting provincial commander at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as acting provincial commander at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 十三年，駐藏副都統傅清當代，命拉布敦往。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the deputy commander in Tibet, Fu Qing, was due to be relieved; Labudun was ordered to go.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Fu Qing's term as deputy commander in Tibet ended; Labudun was sent to replace him.

sentences.zh: 十四年，召還，以紀山代，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was recalled; Ji Shan replaced him and he was appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was recalled; Ji Shan replaced him and he became Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 未終歲，上徵紀山還，復命赴藏。

translations.literal: Before the year was out the Emperor summoned Ji Shan back and again ordered Labudun to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Before the year ended the Emperor recalled Ji Shan and sent Labudun to Tibet again.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授左都御史。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 尋與傅清謀誅珠爾默特那木札勒，其黨羅卜藏札什圍樓，拉布敦挾刃躍下樓，擊殺數十人，自剖其腹死。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Fu Qing in plotting to kill Dondrup Namjal; when Lobzang Tashi's party besieged the tower Labudun seized a blade, leaped from the tower, killed several dozen men, and disemboweled himself.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and Fu Qing killed Dondrup Namjal; when Lobzang Tashi besieged the tower Labudun leaped down blade in hand, cut down dozens, then disemboweled himself.

sentences.zh: 上聞，贈爵、賜金、立祠如傅清。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it he granted enfeoffment, gold, and a shrine as for Fu Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On news of his death the Emperor granted enfeoffment, gold, and a shrine matching Fu Qing's honors.

sentences.zh: 命以拉布敦之族升隸正黃旗，諡壯果。

translations.literal: He ordered Labudun's clan promoted to the Plain Yellow Banner with the posthumous title Zhuangguo.
translations.idiomatic: Labudun's clan was raised to the Plain Yellow Banner with the posthumous title Zhuangguo.

sentences.zh: 子隆保，以侍衛襲子爵。

translations.literal: His son Longbao inherited the viscounty as a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Longbao inherited the viscounty as a guardsman.

sentences.zh: 誤班奪官，爵除。

translations.literal: Through a clerical error his office and title were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: A clerical error cost him his office and the title lapsed.

sentences.zh: 班第，博爾濟吉特氏，蒙古鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Bandi, of the Borjigit clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi, of the Borjigit clan, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Mongol.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，自官學生授內閣中書。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi reign he was appointed a Secretariat drafter from the Imperial Academy students.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi he rose from Imperial Academy student to Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 五遷，雍正初至內閣學士。

translations.literal: After five promotions, at the beginning of Yongzheng he reached Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: Five promotions brought him to Grand Secretariat academician early in Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 四川、雲南徼外與西藏定界，命偕副都統鄂齊如西藏宣諭。

translations.literal: When the borders beyond Sichuan and Yunnan were fixed with Tibet he was ordered, together with Deputy Commander Eqi, to go to Tibet to proclaim the settlement.
translations.idiomatic: When Sichuan and Yunnan frontiers with Tibet were delimited, he and Deputy Commander Eqi went to Tibet to proclaim the settlement.

sentences.zh: 遷理籓院侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He became Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 坐事左遷，在內閣學士上行走。

translations.literal: Demoted for an offense, he served at Grand Secretariat academician with reduced rank.
translations.idiomatic: After a demotion he served as academician with reduced standing.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he entered the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，授兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong he was appointed Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3 he became Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 外擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred outward as governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was then posted governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 剿鎮筸、永綏亂苗，兩閱月而畢，上嘉焉。

translations.literal: He suppressed rebellious Miao in Zhenbian and Yongshun; within two months it was finished, and the Emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified Miao rebels in Zhenbian and Yongshun within two months, winning imperial praise.

sentences.zh: 五年，以憂還京師。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he returned to the capital on mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he returned to Beijing on mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 六年，命仍在軍機處行走，授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was again ordered to serve in the Grand Council and was appointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he rejoined the Grand Council as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十三年，師徵金川，授內大臣，出督軍餉，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when troops campaigned against Jinchuan, he was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior and went out to supervise military supplies, with the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, during the Jinchuan campaign, he became a grand minister of the interior supervising military supplies and received the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋按四川巡撫紀山加徵累民狀，命即署巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, investigating reports that Sichuan Provincial Governor Ji Shan had imposed cumulative levies that oppressed the people, he was ordered to act immediately as provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: He soon investigated Ji Shan's cumulative levies in Sichuan and was ordered to serve at once as provincial governor.

sentences.zh: 時訥親、張廣泗師久無功，上諮班第，但言廣泗罪狀，語不及訥親。

translations.literal: At that time Neqin and Zhang Guangsi had led troops for a long time without success; the Emperor consulted Bandi, who spoke only of Zhang Guangsi's offenses and did not mention Neqin.
translations.idiomatic: When Neqin and Zhang Guangsi had long failed on campaign, the Emperor asked Bandi—who condemned only Zhang Guangsi and said nothing of Neqin.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「班第雖職餉，然為本兵軍機大臣，軍事及將弁功罪，皆職掌所在，不得以督餉，一切置不問。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed: "Although Bandi's duty is supplies, as Minister of War and Grand Council minister military affairs and the merits and faults of generals and officers are all within his charge; he may not, because he supervises supplies, set everything aside and not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked him: though his title was supply chief, as Minister of War and councilor he was answerable for campaigns and commanders—he could not ignore military affairs because he handled rations.

sentences.zh: 」左遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: " He was demoted to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: " He was demoted to Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十四年，予副都統銜赴青海辦事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was given the rank of deputy commander and sent to handle affairs in Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he received a deputy commander's seal and went to Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 西藏郡王珠爾默特那木札勒有叛跡，駐藏辦事大臣傅清、拉布敦疏聞。

translations.literal: The Tibetan prince of the commandery Dondrup Namjal showed signs of rebellion; the resident commissioners in Tibet, Fu Qing and Labudun, memorialized the court.
translations.idiomatic: Dondrup Namjal showed rebellion; Fu Qing and Labudun reported from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 上移班第代拉布敦，未至，珠爾默特那木札勒謀益急，傅清、拉布敦召至廨，誅之。

translations.literal: The court shifted Bandi to replace Labudun; before he arrived Dondrup Namjal's plotting grew more urgent, and Fu Qing and Labudun summoned him to their office and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi was ordered to replace Labudun; before he arrived Fu Qing and Labudun lured Dondrup Namjal to their hall and killed him.

sentences.zh: 其徒卓呢、羅卜藏札什等遂叛，傅清、拉布敦死之。

translations.literal: His followers Zhuoni, Lobzang Tashi, and others thereupon rebelled, and Fu Qing and Labudun died.
translations.idiomatic: Followers Zhuoni and Lobzang Tashi rebelled and killed Fu Qing and Labudun.

sentences.zh: 公班第達執卓呢、羅卜藏札什等，班第至，按訊，又得其黨德什奈等凡二十七人，悉誅之。

translations.literal: The Duke Bandida arrested Zhuoni, Lobzang Tashi, and others; when Bandi arrived he conducted inquiries and also obtained their partisans Deshinai and twenty-six others in all, all of whom were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Bandida seized Zhuoni and Lobzang Tashi; Bandi tried the case, found twenty-seven partisans including Deshinai, and executed them all.

sentences.zh: 上以藏酋授王爵名位過重，命班第達以公爵管格隆事，令班第宣諭。

translations.literal: The Emperor considered that Tibetan chiefs had been granted princely titles and ranks too weighty; he ordered Bandida to manage Gelug affairs as a duke and Bandi to proclaim the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Finding Tibetan princely titles too grand, the Emperor had Duke Bandida manage Gelug affairs and Bandi proclaim the change.

sentences.zh: 班第又疏陳珠爾默特那木札勒與準噶爾通書謀叛狀，上命誅珠爾默特那木札勒妻子。

translations.literal: Bandi again memorialized the circumstances of Dondrup Namjal's correspondence with the Dzungars plotting rebellion; the Emperor ordered the execution of Dondrup Namjal's wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi reported Dondrup Namjal's treasonous letters to the Dzungars; the Emperor ordered his family executed.

sentences.zh: 四川總督策楞等以師至，會議西藏善後諸事。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor-General Celeng and others arrived with troops and conferred on various matters of Tibetan pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Celeng and other forces arrived to settle Tibet's aftermath.

sentences.zh: 西藏大定。

translations.literal: Tibet was greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授都統銜。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was granted the rank of commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he received a commander-in-chief's seal.

sentences.zh: 十七年，還京師，仍在軍機處行走，授正紅旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he returned to the capital, again served in the Grand Council, and was appointed commander-in-chief of the Plain Red Banner of the Chinese Martial.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he returned to Beijing, rejoined the Grand Council, and commanded the Plain Red Chinese Martial Banner.

sentences.zh: 出署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as acting governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting governor-general of the two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 十九年，師徵準噶爾，复授兵部尚書，署定邊左副將軍，出北路。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, when troops campaigned against the Dzungars, he was again appointed Minister of War, acting Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier, taking the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he again became Minister of War and acting Left Deputy General on the northern Dzungar route.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾內亂，輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納來降。

translations.literal: The Dzungars were torn by internal disorder; Khoit taiji Amursana came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana, a Khoit taiji, submitted amid Dzungar civil strife.

sentences.zh: 詔以明歲進兵，諭班第籌畫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered advance the following year; Bandi was instructed to plan.
translations.idiomatic: The court set next year for the advance and told Bandi to plan it.

sentences.zh: 班第以軍中駝馬牛羊宜牧地，得扎布堪、呢圭諸處，冬令暖，富水草，令喀爾喀親王額琳沁多爾濟等往督牧。

translations.literal: Bandi, because camels, horses, cattle, and sheep in the army needed pasture, obtained Zhabukan, Nigui, and other places—warm in winter and rich in grass and water—and ordered Khalkha Prince Elinchin Dorji and others to supervise grazing.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi chose winter pastures at Zhabukan and Nigui with rich grass and water and sent Khalkha Prince Elinchin Dorji to oversee grazing for the army's herds.

sentences.zh: 遣兵擒烏梁海宰桑東根、赤倫等，收其眾數千戶。

translations.literal: He sent troops to capture Oirat zaisang Donggen, Chilun, and others and received their people in several thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Troops seized Oirat zaisang Donggen and Chilun and absorbed several thousand households.

sentences.zh: 復令參贊大臣薩喇爾將兵擒準噶爾宰桑庫克新瑪木特、通瑪木特，收其眾，得牲畜無算。

translations.literal: He again ordered Coordinating Commissioner Saral to lead troops and capture Dzungar zaisang Kukxin Mamut and Tong Mamut, receiving their people and livestock beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Coordinating Commissioner Saral captured Dzungar zaisang Kukxin Mamut and Tong Mamut with countless livestock and followers.

sentences.zh: 上獎班第奮勇果斷，予子爵，世授正黃旗領侍衛內大臣，賜白金千。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Bandi's valor and decisiveness, enfeoffed his son as viscount, granted hereditary succession as chief guardsman of the Plain Yellow Banner, and bestowed a thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his boldness, enfeoffed his son as viscount with hereditary guardsmanship in the Plain Yellow Banner, and gave a thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授定北將軍，召來京示方略。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was appointed General for Pacifying the North and summoned to the capital to be shown the strategy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he became General for Pacifying the North and was called to Beijing for the war plan.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，大舉討準噶爾，班第出北路，阿睦爾撒納授定邊左副將軍為副；

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year a great campaign was launched against the Dzungars; Bandi took the northern route and Amursana was made Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier as his second;
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year's first month the great Dzungar campaign opened: Bandi on the northern route with Amursana as his Left Deputy General;

sentences.zh: 永常以定西將軍出西路，薩喇爾授定邊右副將軍為副。

translations.literal: Yongchang as General for Pacifying the West took the western route, with Saral as Right Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier as his second.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang on the western route with Saral as Right Deputy General.

sentences.zh: 班第與阿睦爾撒納等議以二月出師。

translations.literal: Bandi and Amursana and others agreed to march in the second month.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi and Amursana planned a second-month advance.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納將六千人先行，班第將二千人繼其後。

translations.literal: Amursana would lead six thousand men ahead; Bandi would follow with two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana would go first with six thousand; Bandi would follow with two thousand.

sentences.zh: 班第至齊齊克淖爾，以馬不給，令千五百人先，留五百人待馬再進。

translations.literal: When Bandi reached Qiqi Ke Nuoer, because horses were insufficient he sent fifteen hundred men ahead and left five hundred to wait for horses before advancing.
translations.idiomatic: At Qiqi Ke Nuoer, short of horses, Bandi sent fifteen hundred ahead and held five hundred until mounts arrived.

sentences.zh: 至喇托輝，與阿睦爾撒納軍合。

translations.literal: At Latohui he joined Amursana's army.
translations.idiomatic: At Latohui he united with Amursana's force.

sentences.zh: 上以阿睦爾撒納為準噶爾人所知，令其前行易招撫，戒班第仍令阿睦爾撒納先行毋合軍。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Amursana was known to the Dzungars, ordered him to go ahead to make surrender easy, and warned Bandi still to let Amursana advance separately and not combine armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wanted Amursana ahead to win surrenders and warned Bandi not to merge the columns.

sentences.zh: 班第至額爾得里克，復令阿睦爾撒納先行。

translations.literal: When Bandi reached Erderik he again ordered Amursana to advance first.
translations.idiomatic: At Erderik he again sent Amursana forward.

sentences.zh: 四月，師至博羅塔拉，得達瓦齊所遣徵兵使者，知伊犁無備。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the army reached Boluotala and obtained Dawachi's envoy summoning troops, learning that Ili was unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month at Boluotala they captured Dawachi's recruiting envoy and learned Ili was undefended.

sentences.zh: 班第謀約西路軍銳進。

translations.literal: Bandi planned with the western-route army for a swift advance.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi arranged a rapid joint thrust with the western army.

sentences.zh: 五月，遂克伊犁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Ili was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Ili fell.

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊以萬人保格登山，侍衛阿玉錫以二十餘騎擊之，驚走。

translations.literal: Dawachi held Gedeng Mountain with ten thousand men; guardsman Ayusi with a little more than twenty horsemen attacked and drove him off in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi held Gedeng Mountain with ten thousand men until guardsman Ayusi with twenty-odd riders routed him.

sentences.zh: 上獎班第功，封一等誠勇公，賜寶石頂、四團龍補服、金黃絛朝珠。

translations.literal: The Emperor rewarded Bandi's achievement, enfeoffing him as first-class Duke Chengyong with a gem-studded finial, four-round-dragon surcoat, and golden-yellow court beads.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor made him first-class Duke Chengyong with gem finial, four-dragon surcoat, and golden court beads.

sentences.zh: 班第以伊犁厄魯特生計甚艱，不足供大兵，六月，疏請留察哈爾兵三百、喀爾喀兵二百移駐伊犁河北尼楚袞治事。

translations.literal: Bandi, because the livelihood of the Oirats at Ili was very hard and could not support a large army, in the sixth month memorialized to leave three hundred Chahar troops and two hundred Khalkha troops shifted to govern affairs north of the Ili River at Nichu Gun.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi found Ili could not feed a large garrison and in the sixth month asked to leave three hundred Chahar and two hundred Khalkha troops at Nichu Gun north of the Ili River.

sentences.zh: 諸軍次第遣還。

translations.literal: The various armies were sent back in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Other forces were withdrawn in turn.

sentences.zh: 是月，獲達瓦齊，獻俘京師。

translations.literal: That month Dawachi was captured and presented as a captive in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month Dawachi was captured and sent to Beijing as a prisoner.

sentences.zh: 軍初出，上察阿睦爾撒納有異志，令班第嚴約束。

translations.literal: When the army first set out the Emperor perceived Amursana had a different intent and ordered Bandi to restrain him strictly.
translations.idiomatic: From the start the Emperor distrusted Amursana and told Bandi to restrain him.

sentences.zh: 及伊犁既定，上令和碩特四部部置汗，將以阿睦爾撒納為輝特汗。

translations.literal: After Ili was settled the Emperor ordered each of the four Khoshut divisions to have its own khan, intending to make Amursana khan of the Khoit.
translations.idiomatic: After Ili fell the Emperor planned four divisional khans, with Amursana as Khoit khan.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納覬總統四部，意不慊，置副將軍印不用，用故準噶爾台吉噶爾丹策淩菊形小印檄諸部，諱其降，言以中國兵定亂，叛跡漸著。

translations.literal: Amursana coveted presiding over all four divisions and was discontent; he set aside the deputy general's seal and used the old Dzungar taiji Galdan Tseren's chrysanthemum-shaped small seal to command the divisions, concealing his surrender and saying Chinese troops had pacified disorder—rebellion gradually became evident.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana wanted to rule all four tribes, ignored his deputy seal, used Galdan Tseren's old seal to command them, hid his submission, and claimed Chinese troops had only quelled chaos—his rebellion showed plainly.

sentences.zh: 上召阿睦爾撒納，以九月至熱河行在，行飲至禮，與他部汗同受封。

translations.literal: The Emperor summoned Amursana; in the ninth month he reached the imperial camp at Rehe, where the libation ceremony was performed and he received enfeoffment together with khans of the other divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana was summoned to Rehe in the ninth month, toasted with other khans, and enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 參贊大臣色布騰巴爾珠爾率遣還諸軍以歸。

translations.literal: Coordinating Commissioner Sebuteng Balzhuer led the returning troops home.
translations.idiomatic: Coordinating Commissioner Sebuteng Balzhuer led the withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納乞代奏，冀總統四部，期七月俟命。

translations.literal: Amursana begged to memorialize on his behalf, hoping to preside over the four divisions, and set the seventh month to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana asked Sebuteng Balzhuer to plead for rule over all four tribes and promised to wait until the seventh month for an answer.

sentences.zh: 色布騰巴爾珠爾歸，不敢聞。

translations.literal: When Sebuteng Balzhuer returned he dared not report it.
translations.idiomatic: Sebuteng Balzhuer returned but dared not relay the request.

sentences.zh: 以班第趣阿睦爾撒納詣熱河，令參贊大臣額林沁多爾濟與俱。

translations.literal: Because Bandi was pressing Amursana to go to Rehe, the Emperor ordered Coordinating Commissioner Elinchin Dorji to go with him.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi was hurrying Amursana to Rehe; the Emperor sent Elinchin Dorji with him.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納怏怏就道，而上念阿睦爾撒納終且叛，諭班第宜乘其未發討之，毋濡忍貽後患。

translations.literal: Amursana set out resentfully, but the Emperor, thinking he would ultimately rebel, instructed Bandi to strike before he rose and not show undue forbearance that would leave later trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana went unwillingly; the Emperor told Bandi to crush him before he rebelled rather than indulge him.

sentences.zh: 諭至，阿睦爾撒納已行。

translations.literal: When the instruction arrived Amursana had already departed.
translations.idiomatic: The order arrived after Amursana had left.

sentences.zh: 上又命鄂容安等擒治。

translations.literal: The Emperor again ordered E Rong'an and others to seize and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then ordered E Rong'an and others to arrest him.

sentences.zh: 八月，阿睦爾撒納行至烏隴古，解副將軍印還額林沁多爾濟，走額爾齊斯，遂叛。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, when Amursana reached Wulonggu he returned the deputy general's seal to Elinchin Dorji, fled to the Irtysh, and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month at Wulonggu he returned his seal to Elinchin Dorji, fled toward the Irtysh, and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 伊犁道梗。

translations.literal: The road to Ili was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The Ili route was cut.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納之黨克什木、巴朗、敦克多曼集、烏克圖等作亂，班第與鄂容安以五百人拒戰，自固勒札赴空格斯，轉戰至烏蘭庫圖勒，賊大至，圍合。

translations.literal: Amursana's partisans Keshimu, Balang, Dun Ke Duomanji, Wuketu, and others rose in disorder; Bandi and E Rong'an with five hundred men resisted, fighting from Gulezha to Konggesi and on to Wulan Kutule until the rebels came in force and the encirclement closed.
translations.idiomatic: Partisans Keshimu, Balang, and others rebelled; Bandi and E Rong'an with five hundred men fought from Gulezha through Konggesi to Wulan Kutule until overwhelming rebels surrounded them.

sentences.zh: 班第拔劍自剄，鄂容安同殉。

translations.literal: Bandi drew his sword and cut his own throat; E Rong'an died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi killed himself with his sword; E Rong'an died at his side.

sentences.zh: 上初聞班第等陷賊，令參贊大臣策楞自巴里坤間使傳諭毋以身殉。

translations.literal: When the Emperor first heard Bandi and others were trapped by rebels he ordered Coordinating Commissioner Celeng from Barkul by secret messenger to tell them not to die for the cause.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing they were besieged, the Emperor sent Celeng from Barkul with secret orders not to throw their lives away.

sentences.zh: 策楞聞訛傳班第等自賊中出，以聞，上解所佩荷包為賜。

translations.literal: Celeng heard a false report that Bandi and others had emerged from among the rebels and reported it; the Emperor removed the purse from his belt as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng then reported a false rumor they had escaped; the Emperor gave him the purse from his belt.

sentences.zh: 既聞班第等死事狀，降詔謂：「班第、鄂容安見危授命，固為可憫；

translations.literal: After hearing the true account of Bandi and others' deaths, an edict was issued saying: "Bandi and E Rong'an, seeing peril, gave their lives—this is indeed pitiable;
translations.idiomatic: Learning they had died, the Emperor issued an edict: "Bandi and E Rong'an faced danger and gave their lives—pitiable indeed;

sentences.zh: 然於事無補，非傅清、拉布敦為國除兇者比。

translations.literal: yet it was of no help to the affair, not comparable to Fu Qing and Labudun, who removed the villain for the state.
translations.idiomatic: yet their deaths did not advance the cause, unlike Fu Qing and Labudun, who slew a traitor for the realm."

sentences.zh: 」二十一年，師复定伊犁。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-first year the army again pacified Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the army recovered Ili.

sentences.zh: 喪還，上親臨奠，並令執克什木、巴朗等，馘耳以祭。

translations.literal: When the coffins returned the Emperor came in person to mourn and ordered Keshimu, Balang, and others seized and their ears cut off as sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When their coffins returned he mourned in person and had Keshimu and Balang beheaded, their ears offered in sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 又以薩喇爾同陷賊不能死，令監往旁視。

translations.literal: Because Saral was trapped with them yet could not die, he was ordered to watch under guard.
translations.idiomatic: Saral, who had been trapped but survived, was made to watch under guard.

sentences.zh: 尋以班第義烈，仍如傅清、拉布敦故事，京師建祠，亦曰雙忠。

translations.literal: Soon, because of Bandi's loyal martyrdom, following the precedent of Fu Qing and Labudun a shrine was built in the capital, also named Shuangzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Later, honoring Bandi's martyrdom like Fu Qing and Labudun, a capital shrine was built, also called Shuangzhong.

sentences.zh: 旋復命圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He was soon again ordered to have his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was soon ordered for the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 子巴祿，初以察哈爾總管從軍，襲一等誠勇公，授鑲紅旗蒙古都統，從定伊犁。

translations.literal: His son Balu, who had first followed the army as Chahar commander, inherited the first-class Duke Chengyong, was appointed commander of the Bordered Red Mongol Banner, and joined in pacifying Ili.
translations.idiomatic: His son Balu, who had campaigned as Chahar commander, inherited Duke Chengyong, commanded the Bordered Red Mongols, and helped pacify Ili.

sentences.zh: 師討霍集占，授參贊大臣，授將軍兆惠有功，命駐軍和闐。

translations.literal: When troops campaigned against Khoja Jahan, he was made coordinating commissioner; for merit supporting General Zhaohui he was ordered to garrison at Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Khoja Jahan he became coordinating commissioner and, aiding General Zhaohui, garrisoned Khotan.

sentences.zh: 戰伊西洱庫爾淖爾，屢敗霍集占。

translations.literal: At the battle of Yixierkuer Lake he repeatedly defeated Khoja Jahan.
translations.idiomatic: At Yixierkuer Lake he repeatedly defeated Khoja Jahan.

sentences.zh: 師還，加雲騎尉世職，圖形紫光閣，為後五十功臣首。

translations.literal: When the army returned a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank was added; his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor as the first of the later fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On return he gained a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank and led the later fifty meritorious portraits in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 出為涼州、綏遠城將軍、察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: He went out as general at Liangzhou and Suiyuan, and as Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as general at Liangzhou and Suiyuan and as Chahar commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安，字休如，西林覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，大學士鄂爾泰長子。

translations.literal: E Rong'an, style Xiuru, of the Xilin Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner, eldest son of Grand Secretary Ortai.
translations.idiomatic: E Rong'an, courtesy name Xiuru, of the Xilin Gioro clan and Bordered Blue Banner, was Grand Secretary Ortai's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 雍正十一年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongzheng he passed the jinshi examination and was made a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Yongzheng 11 and entered the Hanlin as a bachelor.

sentences.zh: 世宗命充軍機處章京。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor ordered him to serve as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong appointed him a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，授編修，南書房行走。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was appointed compiler and served in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he became a compiler in the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 再遷，五年，授詹事府詹事。

translations.literal: After two more promotions, in the fifth year he was appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Two promotions later, in the fifth year he became Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰承旨固辭，上曰：「鄂容安與張廷玉子若靄，皇考命在軍機處行走，本欲造就成材。

translations.literal: Ortai, following an edict, firmly declined; the Emperor said: "E Rong'an and Zhang Tingyu's son Ruai—my father ordered them to serve in the Grand Council, intending to train them into capable men.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai tried to decline on edict; the Emperor said E Rong'an and Zhang Tingyu's son Ruai had been placed in the council by his father to train them.

sentences.zh: 朕茲擢用，鄂爾泰毋以己意辭。

translations.literal: I now promote him; Ortai must not decline according to his own wish.
translations.idiomatic: "I promote him now—Ortai must not refuse from private feeling."

sentences.zh: 」是時直軍機處大臣與章京皆曰行走，無異辭也。

translations.literal: " At that time Grand Council ministers and clerks were all called "serving in attendance," with no difference in wording.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Council ministers and clerks alike were then called "serving in attendance."

sentences.zh: 尋又命上書房行走。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered to serve in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon also assigned to the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 七年，以與聞左副都御史仲永檀密奏留中事，奪職，語在永檀傳。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, for knowing of Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhong Yongtan's secret memorial held back at court, he was stripped of office—the account appears in Yongtan's biography.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he lost office for knowing of Vice Censor Zhong Yongtan's suppressed memorial—the story is in Yongtan's biography.

sentences.zh: 八年，命仍在上書房行走，授國子監祭酒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered again to serve in the Upper Study and was appointed Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he returned to the Upper Study as Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 十年，襲三等伯爵，後五年加號襄勤。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he inherited a third-class earldom; five years later the designation Xiangqin was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he inherited a third-class earldom; five years later gained the posthumous style Xiangqin.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he became Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十三年，出為河南巡撫，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he went out as provincial governor of Henan and was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he became Henan governor and received a peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 河南境伏牛山界陝西、湖北二省，袤延八百餘裡，鄂容安行部入山親勘。

translations.literal: The Funiu Mountains in Henan border Shaanxi and Hubei and extend more than eight hundred li; E Rong'an on tour entered the mountains to inspect in person.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's Funiu range, over eight hundred li along the Shaanxi and Hubei borders, he inspected in person on tour.

sentences.zh: 又以界上諸關通大道，易藏奸宄，飭行保甲，入奏，上嘉焉。

translations.literal: Because passes on the border opened on main roads and easily hid wrongdoers, he ordered baojia enforcement and memorialized; the Emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He tightened baojia along major passes where bandits hid and won praise.

sentences.zh: 衛輝參將阮玉堂督操，鞭所部兵，兵譁。

translations.literal: Wei Hui Battalion Commander Ruan Yutang supervised drill and flogged his troops; the soldiers mutinied.
translations.idiomatic: At Wei Hui, Commander Ruan Yutang's flogging during drill sparked a mutiny.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安疏請先治譁兵罪，然後罷玉堂，毋令兵驕，亦當上指。

translations.literal: E Rong'an memorialized asking first to punish the mutinous soldiers' crime, then to dismiss Yutang, lest the troops grow arrogant—this too met the Emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: E Rong'an asked to punish the mutineers first, then dismiss Yutang, lest troops grow insolent—again matching the Emperor's wish.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安又令糴補諸府、州、縣常平倉榖都二十九萬石有奇，浚治開封、歸德、陳州三府幹枝諸水，以慎蓄洩、廣灌溉。

translations.literal: E Rong'an also ordered purchase to replenish grain in the ever-normal granaries of all prefectures, departments, and counties to a total of more than twenty-nine thousand shi, and dredged the trunk streams of Kaifeng, Guide, and Chenzhou to guard storage and discharge and extend irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: He refilled ever-normal granaries by more than twenty-nine thousand shi and dredged Kaifeng, Guide, and Chenzhou waterways for flood control and irrigation.

sentences.zh: 上獎其留心本務。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his attention to fundamental duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his attention to fundamentals.

sentences.zh: 十五年，上巡幸河南，鄂容安疏言河南士民樂輸銀五十八萬七千有奇，上曰：「朕巡幸方岳，從不以絲毫累民，曾何藉於輸將？

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, when the Emperor toured Henan, E Rong'an memorialized that Henan gentry and commoners had gladly contributed more than 587,000 taels of silver; the Emperor said: "When I tour the regions I never burden the people in the slightest—how could I rely on contributions?
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, during the Henan tour, E Rong'an reported gentry and commoners had "gladly" contributed 587,000-odd taels; the Emperor replied that tours should never burden subjects.

sentences.zh: 且省方問俗，勤恤民隱，尚慮助之弗週，豈容供用轉資於下？

translations.literal: Moreover, in touring to observe customs and diligently comfort the people's hardships, I still fear assistance is insufficient—how could I allow supplies to be drawn from below?
translations.idiomatic: He added that he sought to relieve hardship, not draw supplies upward from the people.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安此奏失政體。

translations.literal: E Rong'an's memorial misses the proper form of governance.
translations.idiomatic: "This memorial misses proper governance," he said.

sentences.zh: 其以輸銀還之士民。

translations.literal: Return the contributed silver to gentry and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the silver returned.

sentences.zh: 」鄂容安疏請罪，又言：「士民輸銀出本原，還之恐不免胥吏中飽，仍請允其奏。

translations.literal: " E Rong'an memorialized asking punishment; he also said: "The gentry and commoners contributed silver from their own resources; if returned, I fear clerks and runners will still embezzle in the middle—therefore I still ask that the memorial be approved.
translations.idiomatic: E Rong'an begged punishment and argued return would only feed clerk embezzlement, so the contribution should stand.

sentences.zh: 」上意終不懌。

translations.literal: " The Emperor's mind was ultimately displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor remained displeased.

sentences.zh: 還幸保定，鄂容安入見，不引謝，上詰責，令痛自改悔，不得有絲毫糜費粉飾，為補過之地。

translations.literal: On the return journey, when fortune reached Baoding, E Rong'an had an audience and did not offer thanks; the Emperor interrogated and rebuked him, ordering bitter self-reform and not the slightest waste or ornamentation, to give room for making amends.
translations.idiomatic: At Baoding on the return journey E Rong'an met the Emperor without thanks; rebuked, he was told to reform utterly and waste nothing, to earn a chance to make amends.

sentences.zh: 十六年，移山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to provincial governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 濟南被水，米貴。

translations.literal: Jinan suffered flooding and grain was dear.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan flooded and grain prices soared.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安請用乾隆十三年例，暫弛海禁，招商往奉天糴運。

translations.literal: E Rong'an asked to follow the precedent of Qianlong 13 and temporarily relax the maritime prohibition, inviting merchants to go to Fengtian to purchase grain and transport it.
translations.idiomatic: E Rong'an asked to relax the maritime ban as in Qianlong 13 and recruit merchants to ship grain from Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 旋與東河總督顧琮規塞張秋掛劍台河決，培築運河堤，自台兒莊至德州千有餘裡，循堤建堡房。

translations.literal: Soon, together with Grand Canal Governor Gu Cong, he planned to block the breach at Zhangqiu Guajiantai on the river, build up the Grand Canal embankments for more than a thousand li from Taierzhuang to Dezhou, and along the embankment erect fortified houses.
translations.idiomatic: With Grand Canal Governor Gu Cong he closed the Zhangqiu Guajiantai breach, rebuilt over a thousand li of canal dikes from Taierzhuang to Dezhou, and erected guard houses along them.

sentences.zh: 塞太行堤涵洞，以紓寧陽等縣水患。

translations.literal: He blocked culverts in the Taihang embankment to relieve flooding in Ningyang and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: He sealed Taihang dike culverts to ease floods in Ningyang and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 十七年，疏陳山東州縣吏交代庫銀倉榖多有虧缺，下各府考覈。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he memorialized that in Shandong prefectures and counties many officials on transfer had deficits in treasury silver and granary grain, and ordered each prefecture to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he reported widespread deficits in Shandong treasury silver and granary grain on official transfer and ordered prefectural audits.

sentences.zh: 又移江西巡撫。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to provincial governor of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed governor-general of the two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he became governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十九年，疏言：「江南地廣事繁，胥役弊滋甚。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he memorialized: "The land of Jiangnan is broad and affairs numerous; abuses by clerks and runners are extremely severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he wrote: "Jiangnan is vast and affairs are many—clerk abuses run deep.

sentences.zh: 淮安等府藉賑為弊，蘇州等府藉漕為弊，徐州府藉應徭為弊，當嚴覈懲治。

translations.literal: Huai'an and other prefectures use relief as a pretext for abuse; Suzhou and other prefectures use grain transport; Xuzhou Prefecture uses corvée service—these should be strictly investigated and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an abuses relief, Suzhou abuses grain transport, Xuzhou abuses corvée—all needed strict punishment.

sentences.zh: 令各屬胥吏遵經制原額，禁偽冒及額外無名白役。

translations.literal: He ordered subordinates' clerks and runners to observe the statutory quotas, forbidding impersonation and extra unnamed white laborers.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered clerks to keep statutory quotas and banned impersonation and unnamed extra runners.

sentences.zh: 」是年考績，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: " That year in performance review he was given the additional title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " That year's review brought him the additional title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 上將用兵準噶爾取達瓦齊，以鄂容安年力方盛，勇壯曉暢，召授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: The Emperor was about to use troops against the Dzungars to take Dawachi; because E Rong'an was in the prime of life, brave, robust, and well informed, he was summoned and appointed coordinating commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: As war against Dawachi neared, the Emperor summoned the vigorous, capable E Rong'an as coordinating commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十年，永常以定西將軍出西路，薩喇爾以定邊右副將軍為副，鄂容安實從。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Yongchang went out as General for Pacifying the West on the western route, with Saral as Right Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier as his second; E Rong'an in fact followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Yongchang led the western route with Saral as deputy; E Rong'an went with them.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「漢西域塞外地甚廣，唐初都護開府擴地及西北，今遺阯久湮。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "Beyond the passes in the Western Regions the land outside the frontier is very broad; in early Tang the protectorates and frontier commands expanded territory to the northwest—today those sites have long been lost.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor noted the vast northwest beyond the passes, once Tang protectorates, now lost to memory.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安在軍，凡準噶爾所屬及回部諸地，有與漢、唐史傳相合可援據者，並漢、唐所未至處，當一一諮詢記載。

translations.literal: E Rong'an in the army, for all places belonging to the Dzungars and the various lands of the Muslim regions, wherever there is correspondence with Han and Tang historical records that can be cited, and also places Han and Tang never reached, should inquire and record one by one.
translations.idiomatic: He told E Rong'an to record every Dzungar and Muslim place matching Han and Tang sources—and those beyond them.

sentences.zh: 」旋偕薩喇爾入告，途中撫降諸部落，並檄諭達瓦齊，賚荷包、鼻煙壺。

translations.literal: " Soon he entered the capital together with Saral to report; on the road he pacified and won over various tribes, and also sent a proclamation to Dawachi, bestowing a purse and snuff bottle.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported with Saral, winning tribes en route and sending Dawachi a purse and snuff bottle.

sentences.zh: 及師定伊犁，值胡中藻以賦詩誹上誅。

translations.literal: When the army pacified Ili, it happened that Hu Zhongzao was executed for composing poems slandering the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: When Ili fell, Hu Zhongzao was executed for seditious verse.

sentences.zh: 中藻為鄂爾泰門生，鄂爾泰從子鄂昌與唱和，連坐。

translations.literal: Zhongzao was a student of Ortai; Ortai's nephew Echang harmonized with him and was implicated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzao was Ortai's student; nephew Echang was implicated for joining his verses.

sentences.zh: 上責鄂容安不為陳奏，行賞獨不及。

translations.literal: The Emperor blamed E Rong'an for not memorializing on it; when rewards were distributed he alone was omitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor faulted E Rong'an for not reporting the case; he alone received no reward.

sentences.zh: 命與班第駐守伊犁。

translations.literal: He was ordered to garrison Ili together with Bandi.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to garrison Ili with Bandi.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納叛跡漸著，鄂容安入告。

translations.literal: As Amursana's rebellion gradually became evident, E Rong'an entered the capital to report.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana's rebellion showed, E Rong'an reported to court.

sentences.zh: 上令與薩喇爾率師至塔爾巴哈台相機捕治。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered him, together with Saral, to lead troops to Tarbagatai and seize him as opportunity allowed.
translations.idiomatic: He and Saral were told to take troops to Tarbagatai and seize Amursana when possible.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納入覲，中途遂叛，伊犁諸宰桑應之。

translations.literal: Amursana entered audience but rebelled midway; the various zaisang at Ili responded.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana rebelled en route to audience; Ili zaisang rose with him.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安與班第力戰不支，相顧曰：「今日徒死，於事無濟，負上付託矣！

translations.literal: E Rong'an and Bandi fought hard but could not hold; they looked at each other and said: "Today to die in vain helps nothing and fails the trust the sovereign placed in us!
translations.idiomatic: E Rong'an and Bandi, overwhelmed, said dying now would help nothing and betray the Emperor's trust.

sentences.zh: 」班第自剄。

translations.literal: " Bandi cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: " Bandi cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安腕弱不能下，命其僕剚刃於腹，乃死。

translations.literal: E Rong'an's wrist was too weak to finish; he ordered his servant to drive the blade into his belly, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: Too weak to finish, E Rong'an had his servant drive the blade into his belly.

sentences.zh: 故事，大臣予諡者，內閣擬二諡請上裁，以翰林起家者例諡「文」，至是擬「文剛」、「文烈」，上抹二「文」字，諡剛烈。

translations.literal: By precedent, when ministers receive posthumous titles the Grand Secretariat proposes two titles for the Emperor to decide; those who rose from the Hanlin were customarily given "Wen"; on this occasion "Wengang" and "Wenlie" were proposed—the Emperor struck out both "Wen" characters and gave the posthumous title Ganglie.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat proposed Wengang and Wenlie; the Emperor struck both Wen characters and gave Ganglie.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，上親為贊，有曰：「用違其才，實予之失。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; the Emperor personally composed a eulogy, saying among other things: "Using him against his talent was truly my fault.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait entered the Hall of Purple Splendor with an imperial eulogy: "I misused his talents—that was my fault."

sentences.zh: 」蓋重惜之也。

translations.literal: " This showed how deeply he was cherished.
translations.idiomatic: The lines show how deeply the Emperor regretted his loss.

sentences.zh: 以次子鄂津襲爵，官至伊犁領隊大臣，坐事奪官；

translations.literal: His second son Ejin inherited the title, rose to Ili detachment commander, and lost office for an offense;
translations.idiomatic: Second son Ejin inherited the title, became Ili detachment commander, then lost office;

sentences.zh: 以鄂容安長子鄂岳襲爵。

translations.literal: E Rong'an's eldest son Eyue inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: eldest son Eyue then inherited.

sentences.zh: 納穆札爾，圖伯特氏，蒙古正白旗人，都統拉錫子。

translations.literal: Namuzhal, of the Tubote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, son of Commander-in-chief Laxi.
translations.idiomatic: Namuzhal of the Tubote clan, Plain White Banner Mongol, was Commander Laxi's son.

sentences.zh: 納穆札爾自閒散授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Namuzhal was appointed a blue-plume guardsman from the idle ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as a blue-plume guardsman from the idle rolls.

sentences.zh: 累遷工部侍郎、鑲藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of Works and deputy commander of the Bordered Blue Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Vice Minister of Works and Bordered Blue Manchu deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年，西藏珠爾默特那木札勒之亂既定，命偕班第駐西藏。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong, after the disorder of Dondrup Namjal in Tibet was settled, he was ordered to garrison Tibet together with Bandi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 15, after Tibet's Dondrup Namjal rebellion ended, he garrisoned Tibet with Bandi.

sentences.zh: 議增設噶卜倫，皆予扎薩克銜。

translations.literal: It was decided to add gablun posts, all granted zaisak titles.
translations.idiomatic: New gablun posts were created, each with a zaisak title.

sentences.zh: 自喀喇烏蘇至庫車增台八，設兵。

translations.literal: From Kala Wusu to Kucha eight relay stations were added and troops stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Eight relay stations with troops were added from Kala Wusu to Kucha.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾通藏，凡阿里、那克桑、騰格里淖爾、阿哈雅克四路，各於隘口設卡倫。

translations.literal: Where the Dzungars connected with Tibet, on the four routes of Ali, Nakexang, Tenggeli Nuor, and Ahayak, border posts were set at each pass.
translations.idiomatic: On four Dzungar-Tibet routes—Ali, Nakexang, Tenggeli Nuor, and Ahayak—passes received border posts.

sentences.zh: 又有勒底雅路，為準噶爾犯藏時間道，亦駐兵防守。

translations.literal: There was also the Lediya route, a secret path used when Dzungars invaded Tibet; troops were also stationed there for defense.
translations.idiomatic: The secret Lediya route used in Dzungar invasions was garrisoned as well.

sentences.zh: 迭疏陳請，皆如議行。

translations.literal: Memorial after memorial was submitted and all approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: His successive proposals were all approved.

sentences.zh: 十九年，杜爾伯特諸部來降，命赴北路料理游牧。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, when the various tribes of the Torghuts came to surrender, he was ordered to go to the northern route to manage nomadic settlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he went north to settle surrendering Torghut tribes.

sentences.zh: 偕喀爾喀親王得親扎布規畫安置輝特、和碩特十三旗於固爾班舒魯克，杜爾伯特十旗於鄂爾海西喇烏蘇，分界駐牧，設卡倫防範。

translations.literal: Together with Khalkha Prince Deqin Zhab he planned to settle the thirteen banners of the Khoit and Khoshut at Guerban Shuluke and the ten Torghut banners at west of Erhai Xila Wusu, dividing boundaries for grazing and setting border posts for defense.
translations.idiomatic: With Khalkha Prince Deqin Zhab he settled thirteen Khoit and Khoshut banners at Guerban Shuluke and ten Torghut banners west of Erhai Xila Wusu, with border posts between them.

sentences.zh: 納穆札爾撫降人頗至，當夏，慮赴京領餉不耐炎暑，請遣使轉餉至張家口散給；

translations.literal: Namuzhal was quite thorough in pacifying and winning over those who surrendered; in summer, fearing they could not endure the heat in going to the capital to draw pay, he asked to send envoys to transfer pay to Zhangjiakou for distribution;
translations.idiomatic: He won surrendering tribes skillfully; in summer, fearing heat on the Beijing pay run, he routed pay through Zhangjiakou;

sentences.zh: 及秋，杜爾伯特諸旗遇霜雪損畜，入告，予米五百石賑撫。

translations.literal: in autumn the Torghut banners met frost and snow that damaged livestock; he reported and was granted five hundred shi of grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: in autumn frost killed Torghut livestock; he secured five hundred shi of relief grain.

sentences.zh: 輝特、和碩特諸旗生計絀，奏濟以糧畜。

translations.literal: The livelihood of the Khoit and Khoshut banners was strained; he memorialized to aid them with grain and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought grain and livestock aid for struggling Khoit and Khoshut banners.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納叛，命駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: When Amursana rebelled he was ordered to garrison Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana rebelled he garrisoned Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 旋移戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was shifted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，和托輝特台吉青滾雜卜亦叛，納穆札爾慮喀爾喀諸部為所動，傳檄諭以利害。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Torghut taiji Chinggun Zhab also rebelled; Namuzhal, fearing the Khalkha tribes would be swayed, sent proclamations explaining advantage and harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Torghut taiji Chinggun Zhab rebelled; Namuzhal warned Khalkha tribes by proclamation.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，授參贊大臣，從將軍成袞扎布率索倫兵追捕青滾雜卜。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this and appointed him coordinating commissioner to follow General Cheng Gun Zhab leading Solon troops in pursuit of Chinggun Zhab.
translations.idiomatic: Praised, he became coordinating commissioner under General Cheng Gun Zhab pursuing Chinggun Zhab with Solon troops.

sentences.zh: 十一月，師至杭哈獎噶斯，已近俄羅斯境，捕得青滾雜卜，檻送京師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the army reached Hangha Jiangasi, already near the Russian border; Chinggun Zhab was captured and sent to the capital in a cangue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month at Hangha Jiangasi near Russia they captured Chinggun Zhab and sent him to Beijing in a cangue.

sentences.zh: 上獎納穆札爾勇往，封一等伯，世襲，號曰勤襄。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Namuzhal's bold advance, enfeoffed him as first-class baron with hereditary succession, posthumous style Qinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor made him hereditary first-class baron Qinxiang for his bold pursuit.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授工部尚書、正紅旗滿洲都統，命駐科布多。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed Minister of Works and commander-in-chief of the Plain Red Banner of the Manchus, and ordered to garrison Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he became Minister of Works, Plain Red commander, and Kobdo garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 旋又命移駐布延圖。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered to shift his garrison to Buyantu.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon shifted to Buyantu.

sentences.zh: 十月，署定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he acted as Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he acted as Left Deputy General.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，議烏梁海降人酋曰察達克所屬鄂拓克置得木齊、收楞額，治庶事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was decided that among Oirat surrendering chiefs, Chadaq's otok would be placed at Demuqi and Shouleng'e to handle general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Oirat chief Chadaq's otok was placed at Demuqi and Shouleng'e for civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 請以得木齊改佐領，收楞額改驍騎校，歲貢貂皮送烏里雅蘇台，賚以緞布。

translations.literal: He asked that Demuqi be changed to company commandership and Shouleng'e to valiant cavalry captain, annually presenting sable pelts to Uliassutai in exchange for satin and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Demuqi became company commandership and Shouleng'e valiant cavalry captain, trading annual sable pelts at Uliassutai for satin and cloth.

sentences.zh: 疏入，如所議。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered it was approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 師討霍集占，复授參贊大臣，出西路。

translations.literal: When troops campaigned against Khoja Jahan he was again appointed coordinating commissioner, taking the western route.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Khoja Jahan he again took the western route as coordinating commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋授靖逆將軍，會雅爾哈善攻庫車。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed General for Pacifying Rebellion and joined Yahir Hasan in attacking Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: He became General for Pacifying Rebellion and attacked Kucha with Yahir Hasan.

sentences.zh: 及兆惠代雅爾哈善，將師自阿克蘇進逼葉爾羌，至喀喇烏蘇，為霍集占所圍。

translations.literal: When Zhaohui replaced Yahir Hasan and led the army from Aksu to press Yarkand, reaching Kala Wusu, he was surrounded by Khoja Jahan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaohui replaced Yahir Hasan and advanced from Aksu toward Yarkand, Khoja Jahan trapped him at Kala Wusu.

sentences.zh: 納穆札爾及參贊大臣三泰先奉命帥師濟兆惠軍，兆惠遣副都統愛隆阿、侍衛奎瑪岱來迎。

translations.literal: Namuzhal and Coordinating Commissioner San Tai had first been ordered to lead troops to relieve Zhaohui's army; Zhaohui sent Deputy Commander Ailong'a and guardsman Kuimadai to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: Namuzhal and San Tai were ordered to relieve Zhaohui; Zhaohui sent Ailong'a and Kuimadai to meet them.

sentences.zh: 納穆札爾道遣愛隆阿先還，而與三泰、奎瑪岱將二百騎夜進，遇賊三千餘，圍數重，力戰矢盡，遂沒於陣。
